subject: Genetics
title: Genetic Counseling
description: Learn Genetic Counseling in one minute.

hook.text: A test says you carry BRCA. What does that mean for you? For your kids? A genetic counselor explains.

buildup.text: Genetic counselors translate probability into decisions. They help families understand risk, not just raw results.

discovery.text: The field emerged in the 1970s. Today, demand exceeds supply—too few trained counselors for growing need.

twist.text: AI chatbots are being tested for basic genetic counseling. But empathy and nuance remain deeply human skills.

climax.text: As genetic testing expands, counseling becomes essential. Data without interpretation is noise, not knowledge.

punchline.text: The test gives data. The counselor gives meaning.

quiz.question: What do genetic counselors primarily do?
options: Help families understand genetic results and risks
